title: A strong-convexity fidelity optimizer transfers approximate invariance without additive smoothing error

statement.quantifiers: Every arbitrary family E in one finite dimension with Holevo CAPACITY<=C; every member and a common maximizing-prior mean sigma on its support.
statement.assertion: One canonical smoother G(rho,sigma), normalized to rhohat, gives T(rho,rhohat)<=delta and uniform broadcast preservation g(C,delta,b)->0 at fixed delta, without dimension/eigenvalue/family-size constants.
assumptions: Capacity supremum over ALL finite priors, nats.
Physical support retraction and exact inclusion of sigma.
Substate domination and Renyi-2 DPI imported with their actual fidelity conventions.

inputs: Experiment, fixed C/delta, common relative-entropy center and raw broadcaster.
outputs: A reference-sandwiched experiment preserved by the SAME broadcaster; channelwise EB error transfer.
interface.precision: Exact fixed-tolerance estimate, no efficient algorithm or uniform output alphabet.
costs: M=(1-eta)^-1exp[(C+ln2)/eta] with eta=delta^2/8; huge constants retained.
Nonlinear minimizer not physically applied to unknown input; affine undilution only an error identity.

proof_mechanism: Unique fidelity-plus-Q minimizer has quadratic gap>=lambda||v-G||1^2.
Structured reference transport, trace clipping and two-sided objective comparison preserve approximate invariance.
Normalize with TrG>1/2, fix G(sigma,sigma)=sigma exactly.
Dilute into a fixed sandwich; choose delta BEFORE taking broadcast error to zero.
obstructions: Generic per-state truncation adding delta to invariance cannot replace compatible smoothing.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Construct one common center and stable canonical optimizer whose original-channel invariance error vanishes at each fixed approximation tolerance.

review.source_reported: Source reports internally reconstructed mathematics with scoped independent analytic audits; finite checks are not proof certification; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
